expected_effects.estimate_scope: kind token 'modernization' collides with estimate_scope._VALUE_ADD_TERMS text matching and with PACKAGE_CATEGORY_MODERNIZATION vocabulary (Task 3 landmine)
expected_effects.pricing: economic fields retained verbatim; Task 3 owns the kind-multiplier decision (costing.KIND_MULT has no 'modernization' entry and silently defaults to 1.0)
expected_effects.packages: rehab_packages driver/support predicates key on defect/upgrade and will not partition kind 'modernization' until Task 3 migrates them

entries.atomicity_rationale: Retired in catalog 3.1 (2026-08-08): prices layout/spatial observations (tight layout, fixture placement, clearance) at $5,000-$25,000 per bathroom, not an observable renovation concept. Task 4A canary delta review ruling: layout claims must not price — this item was the largest driver of the unapproved headline-delta breaches. No successor — the concept leaves the catalog.

expected_effects.routing: no v2 retrieval candidate; bathroom layout observations go unresolved instead of resolving to a priced item
expected_effects.pricing: removes the $5,000-$25,000 per-bathroom allowance from candidate estimates (5 of 18 canary properties)
expected_effects.publication: publication gate rejects any artifact still carrying the id; historical artifacts carrying it need re-analysis
